notes.subject: feat(mcp): send host session context to servers that opt in
notes.summary: AgentLink now advertises an MCP session-context extension and sends session id, label, kind and parent session id in tool call _meta to servers that opt in; the VS Code extension supplies the context and the SDK node-host exposes new exports.
